results.note: The described divergence (bash rc0 + warning vs psh rc2) does not appear against bash 5.3.15: BOTH shells exit rc2 with an 'option requires an argument' diagnostic, in the exact repro mode (no -c, stdin=/dev/null) and also under a PTY. psh's invocation.py `_value_option` is unchanged (raises InvocationError status 2), so psh did not change; the bash_expected claim is what fails. Cannot confirm it as a 5.2->5.3 oracle change: no bash 5.2 binary remains (Cellar has only 5.3.15), the 5.3 NEWS has no relevant entry, and the r23 raw evidence (tmp/r23-reports/toplevel.md:84) is a bare 'bash -> rc0 warning' with no quoted output. Diagnostic only (NOT used as oracle): /bin/bash 3.2.57 also gives rc=2 `rcfile: option requires an argument`, which suggests the original 'rc0 warning' observation was a mis-read rather than a 5.2 behavior. Residual difference is message wording only (`rcfile: option requires an argument` vs `--rcfile requires an argument`), which was not the finding. No documented-difference entry is needed; ch17 has no rcfile mention and none is warranted on this evidence.
